# F# Release Announcement

Read [F# release announcements](../skills/release-notes/references/release-announcements.md) before drafting or changing an article.

- From the requested release name, resolve the actual SDK branches, release baseline, parallel stable band, and immutable source pins.
- Produce one F# component article from confirmed shipped changes and relevant prior announcements.
- Use the shared workflow for selection, examples, performance evidence, attribution, review, and publication.

For a per-PR changelog entry, use the [release-notes skill](../skills/release-notes/SKILL.md#version) instead.
